Ahmedabad
Date: - 28/01/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
In continuation of the Notices mentioned in the
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 29.01.2026, Hon’ble
Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K. Vishen and
Hon’ble Ms. Justice Nisha M. Thakore) would take up the
matters notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble Court (Coram :
Hon’ble the Mr. Justice A. Y. Kogje and Hon’ble Mr. Justice J. L.
Odedra.)
By Order of Hon’ble the Chief Justice
